WITH r AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.County, s.Virtual, sa.AvgScrRead,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
  WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM r
WHERE Virtual IN ('F','V') AND rk <= 5
ORDER BY School;

JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` > 500;

SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumGE1500*1.0/s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.CharterNum, sat.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rnk
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY rnk, s.CharterNum;

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT sc.Street, sc.City, sc.State, sc.Zip
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) ASC, s.cds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
SELECT AVG(sat.NumTstTakr) FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified' AND sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT adm.full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS full_name FROM schools s
  UNION ALL SELECT s.CDSCode, s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2 FROM schools s
  UNION ALL SELECT s.CDSCode, s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3 FROM schools s
) adm ON adm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ss.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
  AND adm.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(adm.full_name) <> '';

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School AS School,
         s.County AS County,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode AND sa.rtype = 'S'
  WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
    AND s.Virtual = 'F'
)
SELECT DISTINCT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY School;
